posts.author: BobH
posts.content_md: I want to thank Joy and Dinesh for hosting a great gathering of a few of us this past weekend. In attendance with them were Tony C., Arturo, Danny, Holomark, Jeff W. and myself. We spent the whole time talking and looking at holograms, and even a few were made. This is something that really should happen more often.

posts.author: Dinesh
posts.content_md:
You're welcome Bob. Thank you all who showed up. I think we all enjoyed the weekend. In addition to shooting holos, there was a lot of holo-talk arising spontaneously all over the lab, which for me was really the best part of it. The conversations that were going on were really quite full of information and I think we were all a little more educated as a result. Meeting face-to-face also created a more intimate atmosphere, where we could put faces to names, and bring up topics of conversations on the fly. There was a lot of back-and-forth about all kinds of different subjects. 

I concur with Bob that there should be more of these. 

Anyway, Here are some of the pics of the event. The full set can be found at the Triple Take Facebook page ( [https://www.facebook.com/TripleTakeHolographics](https://www.facebook.com/TripleTakeHolographics) ). I understand that they are also being shared with the Facebook holography group. We started with a round-table informal discussion covering troubleshooting holograms, discussing Michaelson fringes and other topics. Danny took video, which is being uploaded to You Tube (right, Danny? )

posts.author: Tony DCG
posts.content_md:
I also want to extend thanks to Dinesh and Joy for a very enjoyable weekend. It was great to meet people from the forum and visit with old friends. The lab time was great and much better than the 3rd world lab I use.

I learned some nice tricks that I can't wait to try out.

Look forward to next time!!

Tony

posts.author: Holomark
posts.content_md:
A boat load of thank yous to Joy and Dinesh for their hospitality, both at the lab and their home. You guys are very gracious and generous hosts. I appreciate all that you did for us (me), including dinner Friday night!

Thank yous are also in order for those who brought parts of their holography collection. Danny (and others) I appreciated being able to see all the wonderful holograms and other pieces on display.

It was really nice to meet everyone. It was almost dissapointing how well everyone got along over the long weekend. The real purpose of the meeting was able to shine through - interesting discussions about holograms, techniquies, "secrets" (don't ask, we can't say), procedures, etc. I know I will be incorporating some of the ideas and suggestions received last weekend. 

Again, thanks to all who attended (especially our gracious hosts) - and to those who did not attend, well we hope to see you at the next PCG meeting.

Mark
